title: Revert most of "stratoshark: Inherit patch, build version and version extension from the project"
description:
This reverts most of commit de0949e22a8b1d37b769c3e0c753621f9654a4b5.

Retain increasing the Stratoshark version to 0.10.0, which should
probably have been done after the release-4.6 branch was created.
